```{r setup, include=FALSE}

                  yaml.eval.expr = TRUE)
```

```{r grass-setup1, include=FALSE}
# preparing to use a GRASS database
library(rgrass7)
use_sf()
if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix") {
  Sys.setenv(GRASS_PYTHON = reticulate::py_discover_config() %>% 
                          as.character() %>% 
                          .[1])
}
```
